subject: On-site week: Lifecorp visit — compressing demo to fit itinerary
messages:
From: Dr. Alison Bennett <alison@lifecorphospital.org>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@lifecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-site week: Lifecorp demo + site tour — need to shorten day

Hi Naomi,

Quick heads up about our visit next Tuesday — travel just shifted for a few of our attendees and the onsite day is tighter than we expected. The C-suite flight now lands earlier, but the operations team has a late meeting that won't free up until noon.

Can we compress the planned session into a shorter block? Ideally we'd like:
- 30–40 minute focused demo on core workflows (scheduling + inference ops)
- 20–30 minute Q&A and integration questions

If that isn't feasible on your side, would a hybrid split work (live 30m + recorded walkthrough followed by office-hours Q&A later)? We can be flexible on start time — earliest we can do is 09:30 local. Also, our CTO may arrive slightly late (9:15).

Attaching the site tour logistics for context.

Thanks,
Dr. Alison Bennett
Director, Clinical Innovation
LifeCorp Hospital
Attachment: site-tour-logistics.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dr. Alison Bennett <alison@lifecorphospital.org>, Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@lifecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-site week: Lifecorp demo + site tour — need to shorten day

Jonas / Marissa — forwarding Alison's note. Travel tightened the customer's day and they asked to compress the demo to ~60 minutes with a short Q&A. Options I see: 

Option A (preferred): 09:30–10:30 — 30–40m focused demo (core workflows + quick live query), 20–30m Q&A/deep-dive. We run the integration slides only if asked.
Option B: 09:30–10:00 live product demo, follow-up 45-minute office-hours in the afternoon (remote) for integrators.
Option C: Record a 20m walkthrough ahead of the visit and do a 30–40m live session for the use-case highlights + 20m Q&A (hybrid).

Practical questions:
- Jonas, can you take the 15m integration overview if asked?
- Marissa, can you lead pricing/pilot talk in the Q&A?
- Do we have a short one-page demo narrative I can send to Alison to set expectations? I sketched a compressed-demo-plan (attached).

If everyone is good, I'll propose 09:30–10:30 and send a calendar invite with a short run sheet and recording fallback instructions. If wifi is a concern, we offer a local laptop demo + recorded fallback.

Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: compressed-demo-plan.pdf
From: Dr. Alison Bennett <alison@lifecorphospital.org>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@lifecorp.com>, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-site week: Lifecorp demo + site tour — need to shorten day

Naomi, thanks for the quick reply and for the options. Option A sounds right for our group — 09:30–10:30 local works. We prefer the live demo to start with the clinical scheduling and inference examples, then open to integration and pilot questions.

A few notes: 
- CTO will likely join at ~9:20–9:30 (tight connection).
- We have a short all-hands from 8:30–9:00; 9:30 is good to ensure people are settled.
- Please include any short pre-read or a one-pager so folks know what the 30–40 minute demo will cover.

Can you send a calendar invite (with hybrid dial-in) and the run sheet? If we hit any last-minute travel delays I may ask to switch the Q&A to remote later in the day — please keep that as a fallback.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alison
Dr. Alison Bennett
Director, Clinical Innovation
LifeCorp Hospital
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Alison Bennett <alison@lifecorphospital.org>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@lifecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-site week: Lifecorp demo + site tour — compressed schedule confirmed (09:30–10:30)

Thanks, Alison — confirmed 09:30–10:30 local for Tuesday. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics) and I uploaded a one-page run sheet to the shared Drive link below. We will: 

- Start 09:30 with 30–35m focused demo (clinical scheduling, inference ops, live query examples)
- 10:05–10:30 Q&A and pilot next steps (Jonas for integration, Marissa for pilot/pricing)

Logistics & fallback: 
- We'll bring a local laptop with the demo image as an offline fallback in case venue wifi struggles.
- Recording will be available; if the CTO joins late we'll keep the first 10 minutes high-level and point to the recording for the detailed sequence.

Links & attachments:
- Run sheet (short): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_demo_materials
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910
- Attachments: compressed-demo-plan.pdf, calendar-invite.ics

See you Tuesday — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
